title: AI-SDLC Workspace
description: Declares a multi-repository project: one parent folder containing N git repositories as subfolders, governed by a single shared .ai-sdlc/ config and one backlog at the parent. This is an ai-sdlc extension beyond the reference framework, which only supports ad-hoc sibling checkouts via permittedExternalPaths (RFC-0010 makes cross-clone a non-goal). The Workspace resource lives at <parent>/.ai-sdlc/workspace.yaml. When present, backlog tasks MUST set targetRepo (backlog-task.v1) to name the repo they modify; the orchestrator resolves targetRepo -> spec.repos[].worktreeRoot and creates the per-repo worktree there. Repo subfolders hold NO .ai-sdlc/ of their own (configScope: shared).

configScope.description: shared: config + backlog live once at the parent and apply to every repo (the ai-sdlc default and the only mode the DoR/pipeline honor in workspace mode). per-repo: reserved for compatibility with the reference cascade model; not recommended.

backlogRoot.description: Parent-relative path to the single shared backlog directory. All tasks for every repo live here; each task names its repo via targetRepo.

repos.description: The repositories that compose this project, each checked out as a subfolder of the parent workspace folder.

id.description: Stable key referenced by a task's targetRepo and by cross-repo dependencies. DNS-label format.

path.description: Parent-relative path to the repo's working tree (e.g. './web'). Must resolve inside the workspace parent folder (path-traversal outside the parent is rejected by the loader).

remote.description: Optional git remote URL, used by init to clone the repo if the subfolder is absent.

defaultBranch.description: The branch the parent tree stays on (Pattern C read-only base) and the target branch for PRs in this repo.

worktreeRoot.description: Parent-relative directory under which per-task worktrees for THIS repo are created (default '<path>/.worktrees'). Kept under the targeted repo so each worktree is a worktree of that repo's clone, never a cross-clone worktree.

crossRepo.description: Cross-repository behavior for the dependency graph and admission.

depGraphSpanning.description: When true, a task's dependencies[] may reference tasks whose targetRepo differs from this task's. The orchestrator builds a single dependency graph spanning all repos and admits a task only when its cross-repo upstreams are complete. When false, dependencies must stay within the same targetRepo.
